main_text.l: {φιλ[?]} Iuventuti gratificandi causa, σω[?] δήμου Habacuco adiungam.

Fateor autem me, toto hoc anno, quo mea domi vixisti, documētis pietatis erga Deū, iusticiæ erga homines, candoris in interpretandis aliorū dictis factisq;, singularis diligentiæ in studio Ciuilis sapientiæ, sic esse delectatum, ut Deo inprimis donorum istorum auctori benignissimo sæpè gratias agerem, & ea tibi & præstantissimis tuis Parentibus & Propinquis tacitus ex animo gratularer.

Renocasti mihi in memoriam nobile exemplum singularis diligentiæ in studio lingua Latina & Historia, Iuuenis nobilissimi, & optatissimi quondam hospitis mei, affinis tui, IOANNIS ADOLPHI À BOCKVVOLD, qui dum apud nos Basilea uiueret, assiduitate in studio optimarum literarum, expeētationem: egregio successu, iudicium meum, longè felicissimé uicit.
Erit autem uirtutis humanitatisq; tuæ, Hypomnemata ista tuo inscripta nomini, uelut μνημόσυνον nostri contubernij, quod tibi cum lectissimis et nobilibus Iuuenibus uer-

page.notes: The first Greek word of the page, at the start of the first line, is uncertain and marked [?]; the Greek word before "Habacuco" is also uncertain, as is the Greek word at the line end after "σω". The word "δήμου" is read with some doubt. Printed spellings kept as they are, including "expeētationem", "felicissimé", "documētis" and "contubernij". The printed "VV" in "BOCKVVOLD" is kept as printed. Blotches on the right edge are stains, not text.
